_readme: Terrain lane: biomes × terrain_entries × sizes[] × seeds. Filenames include WxH. Optional footprint_tiles_*, composition, category on entries.
prompt_template: top-down seamless terrain tile texture, {subject}, hand-painted Heroes of Might and Magic III inspired fantasy strategy map art, readable macro shapes at map zoom, tileable impression without busy micro-noise, no freestanding buildings, no characters, no creatures, no UI, biome palette and materials: {biome_hint}
negative_prompt: blurry, noisy texture, oversharpen, person, human, character, face, dragon, troops, units, watermark, logo, text, isometric sprite, vertical cliff monument
